prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original 2D side-scrolling action adventure GAMEPLAY DESIGN PLATE, Whale Fall: Echoes of the Tide V4.3. Reference image is ONLY our owned Tidekeeper identity. Preserve exactly one circular DARK LENS in a round ivory diving helmet, short petrol-teal cape, charcoal limbs, broad webbed feet, ONE sealed amber lamp at LEFT hip, coral-red tether and U-shaped TWO-prong resonance tool (never a blade). Three-head-tall proportions; do not turn hero into white mask knight. Art direction: confident clean near-black ink contours, two or three broad flat painted values, very sparse texture, strongly readable silhouette, dark foreground framing, clear playable middle plane, low-contrast atmospheric backgrounds. Poetic underwater ruins of a DEAD whale, tiny shell shelters and red repair knots, no human architecture. A strong action-adventure visual explanation, NOT just a pretty landscape. Landscape canvas about 16:9, high resolution. Panels must be distinct and strictly regular, correct left-to-right top-to-bottom numbering. Only requested numbered labels; no wordy text, no title, no copied HUD. Every action pose retains hero identity. Effects small enough to see enemy and weapon; bone fork always visibly has two prongs. Avoid Horned white knight, paired black eye mask, insect kingdom, nail weapon, stag station, gothic city, crowns, human warriors, recognizable Hollow Knight characters/enemies/bosses/maps/UI/logos. No naked flame, no whale revival, no gore. Treat the style as general hand-inked atmospheric action art, never trace a specific existing game composition. Layout: EXACTLY 6 panels in a 3-column by 2-row grid, all the same size. Thin plain gutters. Each panel 01-06 has sufficient space for visible characters, floor and safe path. Six 2D gameplay close-up panels. 01 horizontal current dash through a thin current curtain between two ledges. 02 translucent buoyant shoulder mantle lifts hero from low membrane shelf toward a fixed refill pod. 03 coral rope connects hip harness to ONE fixed bone ring, hero hanging then releasing toward a platform. 04 U-fork meets an intact ring-marked pearl and hero rebounds upward toward a ledge, NO downward sword strike. 05 hero compresses cloak and membrane through a short soft-wall slit with visible exit, solid bone stays opaque. 06 hero falls onto broad fungal recovery shelf, return stairs visible, single grounded pose with earlier faint fall trail. Clear contrast, safe amber route and red hazard only as small graphic accents.
